content:
According to reports, new Apple products will be announced on October 13, including an upgraded Apple TV 4K. Below are the two major upgrades rumored for the new Apple TV.

#1: Siri AI

When Apple first unveiled Siri AI in June this year, it was positioned as a cross-platform overhaul, delivering a consistent experience regardless of which device users were on.

The new Siri has already landed on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro. But notably, no mention has been made of Siri AI coming to Apple TV or HomePod. And in last month's slate of OS 27 updates, tvOS and HomePod software were the only two systems not to include the new Siri.

That is set to change, however, with Siri AI reportedly set to be a major feature of the new Apple TV 4K.

Based on how Siri AI has performed on other platforms, this would bring a major upgrade to tvOS users. Alongside stronger intelligent understanding of TV shows and movies, more accurate content recommendations, and likely support for an enhanced InSight feature, the new Siri should also be able to answer all manner of general-knowledge queries, just as it does on other devices.

#2: Upgrade from current A15 Bionic to an A19-class chip

The Apple TV 4K has not been updated since 2022, and that model featured an A15 chip dating back to 2021.

However, rumors suggest the new Apple TV 4K, due to debut next week, will bring a major chip upgrade, packing an A19 or A19 Pro chip.

Leaker Aaron Perris spotted a new hardware model designated "AppleTV18,1" in Apple code. The "18,1" naming convention is also used for the iPhone 17 lineup, suggesting an A19-class chip.

I'd wager it will be the A19 Pro rather than the A19, since the latter doesn't support the ability to customize the speed and tone of Siri AI's speech. Given Siri AI is a key focus of the new Apple TV, the A19 Pro seems the safer bet.
